'''Meena Tills''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] together with the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tills and Dowmeia replaced former Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], who defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
Early in the Clone Wars, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Tills was kidnapped and [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege|held hostage]] at the [[Galactic City Spaceport]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a group of [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. After a lengthy stand off with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and the brutal murder of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kaim|negotiator]], Tills and the other hostages at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] were rescued by [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC trooper]] [[Ordo Skirata|N-11]] and the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]].<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref>

[[File:MeenaTills-WW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tills orders Captain [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] to protect Prince [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]]]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tills was present during a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|second battle]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], as the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people sided with the Republic, while the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] were backed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Tills was caught in the midst of this conflict, advising where she<ref name="SWE" /> could while under the protection of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clone troopers.<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

She was later present in the Galactic Senate when it was announced that interest rates on the Republic would be raised by the Banking Clan because the Separatists were refusing to pay their loans. She expressed her concerns along with Senators [[Mot-Not Rab]] and [[Kin Robb]]. When Senator Robb called for a counter-invasion in order to seize the banks, Tills supported her.

A staunch [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]], she was one of the leading political figures behind the [[Delegation of 2000]], a movement in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that opposed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] staying in power. She was part of the group that presented the [[Petition of 2000]] to Palpatine following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. The document would later be used to incriminate many Loyalists, including Tills, under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

[[File:MeenaTills-WoSW.png|thumb|right|200px|Tills was one of the leading members behind the Delegation of 2000.]]
After the formation of the Empire, Senator Tills was arrested and her people and planet were enslaved. However, she eventually escaped captivity, and was eventually issued with a bounty on her head sometime prior to the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="STAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, here's the thing about that: Meena Tills is a name based on a Lucasfilm employee and friend of mine, Tina Mills. And in that regard, it makes absolute zero sense in Lucasfilm that Meena Tills would be a man.|Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="Forcecast">{{WebCite|url=http://forcecast.net/story/home/Weekly_ForceCast_September_16_2011_140594.asp|text=Weekly ForceCast: September 16, 2011|date=2011-09-16|archivedate=20110926003539}}</ref>}}
In [[2011]], the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Water War]]," changed Tills' gender from male to female, and pronouns from he/him to she/her. This discrepancy establishes a continuity error, as Tills, who first appeared in [[George Lucas]]' [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], was portrayed by a male actor and was such in various sources following the film, which also used he/him pronouns for Tills. Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] later clarified that change to be based on the character's original namesake, Lucasfilm employee [[Tina Mills]].<ref name="Forcecast" />
